name: TDD-Bench Verified
description: A high-quality benchmark suite of 449 issues mined from real-world GitHub repositories designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to generate tests for issues before they are resolved, focusing on fail-to-pass test generation and coverage adequacy.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for code test generation from real GitHub issues, with limited but growing interest in software engineering evaluation.
notes: Benchmark includes human-judged and execution-filtered dataset; evaluation harness runs relevant tests in isolation for accurate coverage.
